correctness.rationale: A direct iff signature criterion is proved from row-column incidence sets under nonempty side degrees. The empty-row case is excluded for even order >=6 by >=2(n-1)>3n/2. The defect bound shows all minima have P4 components or precisely one K2 and total remaining defect 2; the only tree shapes are listed. Label allocations using 4 P4, 6 P5, and 36 each of P6/T6 give the four factorial counts. Independent direct exhaustive n=6 computation verifies all 94,143,280 candidate subsets and both proofs of the n=4 exception are bounded; these computations are not substituted for the all-order reasoning.

value.rationale: The even-order paper itself leaves the optimizer families unclassified beyond a known no-isolated-edge equality case and a second example. Exact four-type structure for every even order >=6, a closed factorial enumerator, and asymptotic concentration in the two-P5 class address a natural distinction between feasible optimal arrangements and their scalar minimum. It permits uniform generation and distributional analysis of optimal detector placements. It is not an artificial parameter slice: even parity is the documented missing equality regime.
